name: bad-time
description: Opens Bad Time Simulator (a fan game by Jcw87, recreating the Sans fight from UNDERTALE by Toby Fox) in its own window while Claude works. Not affiliated with either.

onFinish.title: When Claude finishes
onFinish.description: pause or close. pause (default): one fight for the whole session; it stays where you leave it and comes back to the front on your next prompt. close: the window closes after Claude answers and every prompt starts a fresh fight.

delaySeconds.title: Delay before opening
delaySeconds.description: 0 to 30. Seconds Claude must be working before the window opens; shorter turns never open it.

countdownSeconds.title: Countdown before closing (close mode)
countdownSeconds.description: 0 to 10. With onFinish = close: seconds between the done chime and the window closing.

resumeDelaySeconds.title: Grace before the fight resumes
resumeDelaySeconds.description: 0 to 10. Seconds the fight stays frozen after you click back into the game, so you can get ready.

sounds.title: Chime
sounds.description: A different chime when Claude needs you and when Claude is done.

strayKeyGuard.title: Stray-key guard
strayKeyGuard.description: Holds a prompt sent within 1.5 s of the mod closing the window, so game keys never send one by accident.

windowSize.title: Window size
windowSize.description: auto (centered, about 60% of the screen height), or WIDTHxHEIGHT such as 900x700, 320 to 3840 each. The window is resizable either way.

browserPath.title: Browser path
browserPath.description: Full path to Chrome, Edge, Chromium or Brave. Leave empty to find one.

url.title: Game URL
url.description: Must be an https:// address. Point it at a mirror if the original page is down.
